<observations>
Date: May 4 - May 13, 2026
* 🔴 (May 4 - May 13) Kitchen remodel overview: General contractor quote stands at $21,250; appliance allowance is $6,300. Rule: always send photos before opening walls. Pets: dog Bella, cats Whiskers and Luna (temporary safe zone with air purifier arranged, $85).
* 🔴 Fixtures & Finishes: Selected 36-inch undermount stainless sink ($515), matte black 'Eclipse' faucet handles ($135), RiverEdge / Calacatta Gold quartz countertops ($3,200–$4,750), herringbone / Arctic Pearl glass subway tile backsplash, and brushed nickel cabinet hardware ($12 each).
* 🔴 Appliances & Extras: Pull-out pantry drawer, compact fridge (CB-300, $1,120), wine cooler ($920), self-watering herb kit ($85).
* 🟡 Agent managed supplier quotes, virtual demos, lighting options, and paint selections ("Arctic Fog").

Date: May 17, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User confirmed matte white Oakridge 'LunaSeries' cabinets ($1,850 each, delivery June 5) and Arctic Pearl glass tile backsplash ($42/pack).
* 🟡 (11:15) CityPower electrical inspection scheduled for May 20 at 2 PM; plumbing permit PR-2026-517 submitted.
* 🟡 (13:00) Demolition rescheduled to May 27 at 8 AM due to user travel (May 24–26).
* ✅ (14:45) Agent uploaded revised 3-D kitchen model showing cabinets, backsplash, coffee station, and new faucet.

Date: May 21, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User selected StoneCraft 'RiverEdge' light gray quartz countertop (3 slabs ordered, delivery June 8, $3,200 each).
* 🔴 (11:40) User requested EcoTemp Pro smart thermostat integration (scheduled for June 15).
* 🔴 (18:00) User confirmed appliance allowance is $6,300.
* 🟡 (09:20) Sourced three "Nimbus" brushed nickel pendants ($89 each) and added a 12-bottle island wine cooler (ChillBox C12).
* 🟡 (11:05) WaterWorks plumbing rough-in inspection booked for May 28 at 10 AM.
* ✅ (14:00) Agent uploaded revised floor plan showing countertop, island wine cooler, and lighting scheme for user review.
* 🟡 (14:30) Agent sent milestone summary: countertop delivery June 8, lighting installation June 13, thermostat setup June 15.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Awaiting user feedback on the revised floor plan featuring the RiverEdge quartz countertop, island wine cooler, and lighting scheme.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"I've shared the updated floor plan featuring the RiverEdge quartz countertop, island wine cooler, and lighting layout. Would you like to adjust any of these details or move on to the next items?"
</suggested-response>
